pieces.Text: Once every 1d4 rounds as a standard action, a spine dragon can emit a devastating shriek of powerful sonic energy in a
-ft. cone. Creatures caught in this cone take
d6 sonic damage and are permanently deafened. A DC

Reflex save halves the damage and negates the deafness. This sonic damage is particularly devastating to constructs--they take a -4 penalty to save against its effects, and if they fail the save, they are staggered for 1d4 rounds as well.
d6 sonic damage & deafened, Reflex DC
